name: Water Act applicability
triggerRaw: Any establishment discharging trade effluent or sewage, or drawing/using water in a manner covered by Section 25

name: Air Act applicability
triggerRaw: Any premises operating an 'air pollutant' emitting source (DG sets, boilers) above notified capacity thresholds

name: EPA applicability
triggerRaw: Applies to every establishment; gives rise to the subordinate Rules (HWM, SWM, Plastic, Noise, E-Waste, Battery, BMW, C&D)

name: HWM Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Any establishment generating, storing, or transporting hazardous waste (used oil, e-waste, batteries, chemical residues)

name: SWM Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Any establishment generating solid waste above the 'bulk generator' threshold (most hotels/hospitals qualify)

name: Noise Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Applies to premises adjoining or within notified zones (commercial/industrial/silence)

name: PWM Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Brand owners/users of plastic packaging above notified thresholds (F&B outlets, amenities packaging)

name: E-Waste Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Establishments disposing of end-of-life electronic/IT equipment as bulk consumers

name: Battery Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Establishments using DG-set/UPS batteries above bulk-consumer threshold

name: BMW Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres and any healthcare facility generating bio-medical waste

name: CD Rules applicability
triggerRaw: Applies during renovation, refurbishment, or demolition activity generating C&D waste above threshold
